decisions_not_adopted.virtue: Official 바체 adopted; reject worker 버튜.
decisions_not_adopted.english: Worker blanket keep-English claim is not a user instruction; translate confirmed functional UI individually.

other_unconfirmed_scope: Remaining battle HUD/common English, picture markings, artwork captions and runtime/mode consumer paths require further supervision; receipt coverage is not full localization proof.
